title: FIRST MET
author: Ensemble
medium: A wall of 5,966 lamps in the browser (canvas, Web Audio): one per confirmed case, the ones first met dead never light.
embodies: A case count begins at a swab. On 80 readable report days, 1,921 of 5,966 confirmed cases were community deaths: the count first met them dead. The share runs from 15 % to 50 % by day and never leaves.

The Field's study 55: per report day, the distance of the share of cases first met dead from the pooled share in standard errors, and the 99.8 % funnel (z 3.09)

states.changed: The wall of 5,966 lamps, the dark never lit; gather the dark.
Let chance count: every row's dark margin trembles as binomial counting at 32.2 % would draw it, against each day's real edge held still; the two edges chance does not reach turn red.
